shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f

sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat index.html src/* vite.config.ts tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text ThemeProvider Flex Card 2>&1 | head -60

grep -n -i -A8 "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,60p; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor 2>&1 | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json; npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "required setup\|PageConstructorProvider" README.md | sed -n 1,90p; cat build/docs/INDEX.md | sed -n 1,80p; ls build/docs/blocks

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks && sed -n 1,80p Header.md; echo =====; sed -n 1,70p ExtendedFeatures.md; echo ====; sed -n 1,70p Banner.md; grep -n "peerDependencies" -A15 ../../../package.json; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; ls node_modules | grep -i "^sass\|dynamic-import\|diplodoc"; ls node_modules/@diplodoc 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && sed -n 1,60p blocks/PromoFeaturesBlock.md; grep -n "Property\|required" blocks/CardLayout.md | head -20; ls sub-blocks guides; grep -n -i "vite" -B2 -A15 guides/*.md ../../README.md | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -3; npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short; grep -A12 '"dependencies"' package.json

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='vite.config.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("export default defineConfig({\n","export default defineConfig({\n  resolve: {\n    // page-constructor styles use webpack-style `~pkg` imports\n    alias: [{ find: /^~(.*)$/, replacement: '$1' }],\n  },\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|sass-lang\|^\s*[│╷╵]\|^$\|@import\|root stylesheet\|repetitive" | tail -25
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|sass-lang\|^\s*[│╷╵]\|^$\|@import\|root stylesheet\|repetitive\|^\s*node_modules" | tail -25
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|sass-lang\|^\s*[│╷╵]\|^$\|@import\|root stylesheet\|repetitive\|^\s*node_modules" | tail -25
